external_dependency_notice: This index is not self-contained. Absolute external evidence paths must be retained or restored with exact raw bytes; no payload is embedded in these two repository documents.
hash_policy: SHA256 and bytes apply to retained raw external files, without CRLF/LF conversion. Repository proposal files are UTF-8 LF; Git text normalization must not be applied to these external identities.
limits: 17 SVG acquisitions and 17 PNG observations are finite descriptive evidence, not circuit equivalence or equation proofs.
112 primary and eight negative exact reference cases do not cover all 396 source occurrences or arbitrary dimensions/theorems.
No original product notation, Copy/GUI/native acceptance, original notebook/external-runtime execution, whole-lesson or release claim.
Seven negatives retain expected/observed exception outcomes; NEG02 retains both explicit matrix and diagonal-Gram actual/expected mismatch payloads.
Initial P2 packets and reviews are preserved historical findings, not promoted final passes.
